Same follower rule as portal travel, without the portal check. No confirm; the calling GM's view does not change. On another scene the move ends with one pull, as core's own Teleport Token region does: the players who were watching the token there (core's rule) plus `pull` (0.7.0); the same scene pulls nobody. Each follower lands beside the PC; landing counts only the destination floor's tokens and walls.
